name: problem user sort does not reorder
precondition: problem_user is logged in and on the inventory page (/inventory.html). The sort dropdown has its default option, 'Name (A to Z)'. The page shows 6 products.
steps: Note the names and order of the products on the page.
Attempt to select 'Name (Z to A)' in the sort dropdown.
expected_results: The selected option of the sort dropdown remains 'Name (A to Z)'.
The product list still displays items starting with 'Sauce Labs Backpack' and maintains the initial order.
The product list still contains 6 products.
